payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over edges to accumulate distinct neighbor colors per color in sets, then scan all colors to pick the one with max set size; no graph traversal.
payload.rationale: The solution directly computes Q(k) via set unions without exploring the graph structure, making it a data processing algorithm rather than a graph search. Among the given complete_search subtypes, 'search_dfs_bfs_graph' is the least unfitting despite no DFS/BFS usage.
